name: mirage
text: Status: part one is built and fully tested (4,153 tests pass) but not released yet. Master switch: 'Run on GitHub' in Settings. On = the engine does the work and the phone only sends settings and shows status. Off = phone mode: the engine is switched off and trading is set to OFF. Saving a GitHub token turns GitHub mode on. For latency: the phone already polls the engine's status every 2 s while the app is open, using change-checks that cost nothing against GitHub's limit, and every 20 s or more in the background, so I haven't changed that. Still to do before I ship: the audit of what the phone runs while GitHub drives, plus the Kalshi bid-pace and fresh-price fixes. I won't call it done until those are in, so there's no release yet.
